summary: Verified fix for Android 'FontSize should be a positive value' crash (iteration 5, frontend only). Static grep across src/ and app/ confirms no fontSize:0 or dynamic path that can yield 0 (all variants in src/ui.tsx sizes map and ReceiptView TEXT map are positive constants). AccountButton.tsx now renders invisible test markers as zero-sized <View> instead of <T style={fontSize:0}> — comment on line 85 documents the Android caveat. Web regression: distributor (test_token_agent) loads /dist with 5 tabs (tab-index, tab-sale, tab-sales, tab-customers, tab-ops), header renders with testIDs account-button, account-initials, account-name-chip, account-role-chip all present; account sheet opens and shows 'موزع الاختبار'. Owner, Accountant, and Developer dashboards also render the header, open the account sheet correctly, and emit 0 JS console errors. Note: the actual Android IllegalArgumentException is native-only and cannot be reproduced on web preview; the Hermes/Android render pipeline that threw it is bypassed on RN-web (no font metrics on size 0 Text). Static code audit + web regression are the strongest signals available in this environment and they both pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix pattern is correct: replaced <T style={{fontSize:0}}> with zero-sized <View> for test markers. The inline comment on AccountButton.tsx:85 ('never use fontSize 0 — Android crashes') is good defensive documentation.
No other occurrences of fontSize:0 in codebase. All fontSize values in src/ui.tsx, src/components/*, app/* are positive literals (10–26) or come from positive constant maps.

Minor nit (not a bug): the two testID markers account-name-chip and account-role-chip are rendered differently depending on pending.length (nested chip vs sibling zero-sized Views). Tests should not rely on their geometry, only existence — which is how automation uses them.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded test tokens (test_token_agent/owner/acct/dev) via localStorage session_token.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix for Android fontSize:0 crash in AccountButton.tsx is verified on web for all 4 roles. The native Android crash itself can only be re-verified with a native build / EAS build; web preview cannot exercise the RN Android text layout path that threw. If a new render crash is reported on Android, grep for any dynamic fontSize expression that could evaluate to 0 or negative (e.g., scale factors on empty data, numberOfLines-driven adjustsFontSizeToFit, user-provided font sizes).
rca_of_issue: Root cause: AccountButton.tsx previously rendered two invisible <T style={{fontSize:0}}> markers (account-name-chip, account-role-chip) solely for e2e testIDs. On Android, React Native's Hermes-backed text shadow node validates fontSize>0 and throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException('FontSize should be a positive value. Current value: 0') when the distributor header mounts (header renders on every tab). Web/RN-web does not perform this validation, which is why iterations 1–4 passed. Mitigation: replace the invisible Text with zero-sized <View> components that carry the same testID — Views have no font metrics, so Android layout is a no-op. Verified via static grep (no remaining fontSize:0 anywhere) and web regression across all 4 roles with 0 console errors.
